ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Daycare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the largest welfare fraud case ever uncovered in the U.S. and track the ongoing Feeding Our Future scheme
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate those involved
questions: What is the scope of the scandal?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption. By following the money and investigating those involved, we can shed light on the scandal and hold those responsible accountable.
